about_the_game:
Meet your newest miniature fuzzy friend: Dougie Dighog! Dougie has a dream: to dig where no dighog has dug before, a whopping 100 meters down.

In Dougie Dighog's Digging Life, you'll help Dougie dodge traps and critters alike across 100 levels of digging action. But you're not his only help - everyone's favorite herbalist Siris has set up shop nearby! As you dig, you'll be able to gather a variety of resources that you can trade with Siris for helpful items, and complete quests for extra time-limited power boosts. Only the most devoted of diggers will get the chance to harness the power(?) of the mighty Devouthog.

The core gameplay loop involves using your mouse to guide Dougie as he digs through each level of blocks, similar to a classic Breakout-style of game. As you break blocks, items like Starlets and Grubs will appear and can be collected by Dougie or with the mouse cursor, and can be exchanged in Siris's shop for upgrades and items that will allow you to dig further on subsequent days.

What awaits Dougie Dighog at the end of his 100 meter journey? And will he be ready for it? Find out in Dougie Dighog's Digging Life! Plus, once you've made your way down once, try again to set a new speed record - but watch out, the levels are randomized, so you never know what could be next!
